title.zh: 阿里云盘原子操作层：安全登录、双盘读写与断点扫盘
title.en: Aliyun Drive Atomic Ops, Login & Resumable Scan

pain.zh: 用 `aliyunpan` CLI 批处理文件经常踩四个暗坑：默认全局切盘在多任务下串盘；非交互终端拿不到登录扫码链接；目录名带尾空格被解析吞掉；全盘扫描中途断网或限流 `429` 就得从头重扫。
pain.en: Using raw `aliyunpan` CLI in automation breaks easily: global drive switches bleed across tasks, non-interactive shells lose login QR links, trailing spaces in folder names get stripped, and `429` rate limits abort long full-drive scans.

solution.zh: 把阿里云盘命令行封装成带隔离包装器的原子引擎：每条命令强制显式传 `--driveId` 绝不全局切盘；登录失效时用 pty 保活拉出 5 分钟扫码链接交给你本人扫码；批量读写按 200–300ms 节流并严格退避 `429`；全盘 `scan_drive.py` 输出带 SHA-1、保留尾空格且可 `--resume` 断点续扫的 JSONL，遇同名兄弟目录立刻标歧义并阻断下钻。
solution.en: Wrap `aliyunpan` safely inside `run_with_env.py`: pass explicit `--driveId` on every call (never global drive switch), extract 5-minute QR login links via pty keepalive when expired, throttle writes cleanly with `429` backoff, and run resumable multi-threaded JSONL scans (`scan_drive.py`) that preserve trailing spaces and halt on duplicate sibling folder names.

title.zh: 百度网盘原子适配：设备码登录、JSONL 扫盘与安全传输
title.en: Baidu Netdisk Ops, Device Login & JSONL Scan

pain.zh: 百度网盘官方 `bdpan` 与社区 `baidupan-cli` 参数和 JSON 字段不统一，登录容易卡在无浏览器环境，直接解析人类表格还经常把文件名截断、把权限报错当成空目录。
pain.en: Baidu Netdisk CLIs (`bdpan` vs. community `baidupan-cli`) differ in flags and schemas; headless logins stall without QR decoding; and parsing human tables mistakes permission errors for empty folders.

solution.zh: 统一适配官方 `baidu-drive`（`bdpan`）与社区版后端：支持 `--device-code` 生成官方授权链与二维码交你扫码登录；所有命令严禁解析人类表格，只读稳定 JSON 字段，遇 `LIST_FAIL`/权限不足绝不误报空目录；`scan_drive.py` 支持多入口并发只读扫盘与 `.errors`/`.done` 完整收敛。
solution.en: Unify official `bdpan` and community backends behind `run_with_env.py`: decode device-code login QR links cleanly, parse strict JSON fields only (never mistaking `LIST_FAIL` for empty dirs), and run multi-worker resumable JSONL scans with explicit `.errors`/`.done` sidecars.

title.zh: 平台中立 AI-Native Markdown 知识库底座初始化

pain.zh: 想搭一套长期能和 Claude Code、Codex、Obsidian 一起协作的 Markdown 知识库，网上模板一上来就往里塞满 `.obsidian` 插件配置，还会粗暴覆盖你本来就有的笔记和目录。
pain.en: Bootstrapping an AI-native Markdown knowledge base with generic templates often pollutes your folder with hard-coded `.obsidian` plugins or overwrites existing notes without previewing.

solution.zh: 严格按「平台中立 + plan-first + create-only 幂等」初始化 `00–90` 知识库骨架与 `AGENTS.md` 多 AI 适配层：默认先输出完整 JSON `plan`（create / skip / conflict / drift）让你过目，确认后才 `--apply` 建目录和模板，绝不创建 `.obsidian/`、绝不静默覆盖已有文件，最后用 `--check` 校验骨架完整性。
solution.en: Bootstrap a platform-neutral `00–90` Markdown vault and multi-AI `AGENTS.md` layer strictly plan-first and create-only: inspect the JSON `plan` (create/skip/conflict/drift) before `--apply`, never touch `.obsidian/` (handled separately by `bootstrap-vault-obsidian`), never overwrite existing files, and verify structure with `--check`.

pain.zh: 刷到一条干货抖音想收进知识库，分享链接短链难去重、视频文件动辄几十 MB 直接塞进 Git/Obsidian 仓库会把库撑爆，过半年回头找时原视频还可能已经失效下架。
pain.en: Saving a useful Douyin video into Obsidian is tricky: short links resist deduplication, huge MP4 binaries bloat your Git vault, and links expire over time.

solution.zh: 采用「轻量笔记进 Vault + 视频本体落本地 Downloads」分离结构：用匿名一次性无头浏览器拦截视频接口，按 `video_id` 精确去重；MP4 流式下载到 `~/Downloads/soia-pkm-clip-douyin/<video_id>/` 并校验 `ftyp` 文件头，Markdown 笔记只记录文案、互动数据、AI 一句摘要与 `media_local_path` 索引（也支持 `--metadata-only` 纯文案归档）。
solution.en: Keep your vault lightweight while preserving video locally: intercept the stream in an anonymous one-shot Playwright session, deduplicate strictly by `video_id`, verify downloaded MP4 `ftyp` headers in `~/Downloads/soia-pkm-clip-douyin/<video_id>/`, and write clean Markdown notes with `media_local_path` (or `--metadata-only` for text only).

pain.zh: 论文 PDF、汇报 PPT 和 Word 文档直接拖进文件夹里根本搜不到里面写了啥；网上收了一堆 arXiv 或论文网页链接想批量下到本地提取文本，又怕覆盖已有原件、把扫描图片误标成「全文已可检索」。
pain.en: Dropping PDFs, PPTs, and Word files into folders leaves their text unsearchable—while batch-downloading paper URLs risks overwriting files or pretending scanned images have searchable text without OCR.

solution.zh: 针对本地/云盘文档与受控 PDF 列表做严谨提取：计算原件 SHA-256 留证，抽取 PDF/Office 可检索文本并生成带来源元数据的 Markdown；`archive_pdf.py --deep --extract` 支持从 arXiv 摘要页或 HTML 发现真实 PDF，逐条校验 `%PDF-` 魔数与哈希，并严格区分「仅文件名命中」与「经显式 OCR 后才标正文可检索」。
solution.en: Extract searchable text and SHA-256 provenance from PDF, Word, PPT, Excel, and controlled paper URLs (`archive_pdf.py --deep --extract`): discover real PDFs from arXiv/HTML pages, verify `%PDF-` magic bytes, refuse silent overwrites, and separate filename hits from explicit OCR text.

pain.en: Bookmarking GitHub repos leaves you without context later—and naive sync scripts overwrite your personal notes, status tags, and star ratings whenever they refresh repo metadata.

solution.zh: 把源码和知识库彻底解耦：源码只克隆到本机 `upstream` 目录（绝不把代码树塞进 vault），在 Obsidian 里生成项目卡、双链调研笔记骨架和分类索引；重跑刷新时严格区分「自动字段（语言/分类/最近提交）」与「永久保留的人工字段（用途/状态/stars/我的笔记）」，幂等刷新零覆盖风险。
solution.en: Keep source trees cleanly out of your vault (`upstream` directory locally) while maintaining Obsidian project cards, linked research note skeletons, and category indexes. pain.zh: 小红书上存的好笔记、好视频过几天可能就被删帖或搜不到了；手动复制文案漏掉 `#话题#` 和互动数据，直接把视频/原图塞进知识库又会让仓库体积暴涨，还担心乱配置登录态 Cookie 泄露。
pain.en: Saved Rednote posts often get deleted or buried later, manual copy-pasting loses hashtags and metrics, putting videos inside Git bloats the repo, and careless scripts risk leaking `XHS_COOKIE` to untrusted domains.

solution.en: Pure Python 3 stdlib archiver with strict pre-request domain allowlisting (`xiaohongshu.com` / `xhslink.com` only, never forwarding `XHS_COOKIE` to arbitrary hosts or CDNs): parse `noteDetailMap`, preserve hashtags and metrics, store media in Downloads (or `--metadata-only`), and keep `## 我的看法` empty for your own thoughts.

title.zh: 网页、博客、外文长文与公开播客单集归档
title.en: Web, Blog, Bilingual Longform & Podcast Clipper

pain.zh: 网上好文章和好播客太多：普通网页剪藏插件经常把「请先登录 / Cloudflare 人机验证」的拦截页直接存成一篇空壳笔记；外文长文存下来后看不顺手；公开播客分享链接带着一堆跟踪参数，想顺便把音频也留成本地备份更是无从下手。
pain.en: Generic web clippers often silently save 'Please log in' or Cloudflare challenge shells as full notes, leave foreign articles untranslated, and can't strip podcast tracking queries or archive local MP3 audio alongside shownotes.

solution.zh: 集「网页抽取 + 拦截页质检 + 外文意译 + 公开播客音频归档」于一体：抓完网页正文后强制亲读复核，绝不交付拦截壳；非中文长文在文末自动附自然意译 `## 中文译文`（保留命令与专有名词英文）；播客单集用 `archive_podcast.py` 去跟踪参数、收 shownotes、原子下载音频进 `_attachments/podcasts/` 并嵌入 `![[...]]` 播放器，归档完默认交 `organize` 同步更新 MOC。
solution.en: Combine web extraction, anti-paywall quality inspection, natural Chinese translation for foreign articles, and public podcast archiving (`archive_podcast.py`): strip tracking params, save shownotes, atomically download audio to `_attachments/podcasts/` with `![[...]]` embeds, inspect fetched body text to reject challenge pages, and hand off to `organize-article-moc`.

solution.zh: 严守「只同步你自己管理的公众号」底线，提供三条通道按账号灵活路由：路 A 官方 API（免确认，限已认证号）、路 C MP 后台接口（推荐拉历史，仅需地址栏 `token + Cookie`）、路 B 登录态 Cookie 备选；多账号按 alias 隔离配置并默认 fail-closed 防串号，先跑 `--dry-run --limit 3` 探路并按 `url` 递归去重后再写入。
solution.en: Strictly scoped to your own WeChat accounts with three clean routes: Official API (A, verified accounts), MP backend `appmsgpublish` (C, recommended for history), and Cookie fallback (B). pain.en: Saving multi-post X threads or X Articles by hand breaks reply order, leaves `t.co` links unresolved, skips natural Chinese translations—and hundreds of X links piled in Telegram Saved Messages stay buried.

solution.en: No login required via FxTwitter API (with syndication fallback): trace same-author threads and X Articles, expand `t.co` facets cleanly, add natural `## 中文译文` for foreign posts, export native Obsidian PDFs, and batch-import X links from Telegram Saved Messages (`--dry-run` first).

title.zh: 公开 X 账号有限窗口检索、主题研究与导出
title.en: Public X Profile Scoped Research & Filtering

pain.zh: 想系统研究某个 AI 博主最近三个月发过哪些画图提示词或技术观点：一条条手动翻时间线翻到怀疑人生；直接用全网爬虫不仅慢，还经常分不清是只想要研究摘要，还是要把 Prompt 交给下游出图。
pain.en: Researching what an X creator posted about a topic over the last quarter by scrolling timelines is exhausting—and unconstrained scraping mixes up research summaries with downstream prompt exports.

solution.zh: 走 L0–L3 渐进式有限窗口研究流水线：先锁定目标账号、CST 时间窗口、关键词/媒体/ALT 等筛选条件；再以 `--dry-run` 有限分页采集公开帖子，输出可审计的 `summary.md`、`filtered.json` 与分类清单 `classification.yml`；默认停在研究结论，仅当你明确要求时才导出 `image-prompts` 交给生图技能。
solution.en: Run a bounded L0–L3 research pipeline over public X timelines: lock exact handle, CST date window, and keyword/media/ALT filters; preview with `--dry-run` and bounded pagination; emit auditable `summary.md`, `filtered.json`, and `classification.yml`; and hand off `image-prompts` downstream only when explicitly requested.
